prompts.blade-standard-steel-v1:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one modular 2D fantasy weapon component for the Prismatic Adventure kit. Style reference: supplied weapons board, use its angular painterly faceted highlights, silver steel, subtle violet shadows, copper/teal/indigo fantasy palette and broad readable shapes. Single orthographic NEAR-FRONT view, flat broad face toward viewer, upright vertical weapon axis, TIP UP where applicable, no perspective foreshortening or side views. Consistent upper-left lighting. Actual transparent RGBA background, clean alpha, NO floor, shadow, cast shadow, glow, text, watermark, labels, neighboring parts, full assembled weapon, or reference board. 1024x1024 square source canvas with generous transparent margins. Render the requested component large and centered; we will register it to a shared assembly canvas.
Asset ID: blade-standard-steel-v1. Exact component: One STANDARD STRAIGHT SWORD BLADE ONLY, tall slim symmetrical double-edged tapering blade, pointed tip at top, central ridge with angular steel bevel planes, simple rectangular root at bottom. No tang extending beyond root. No guard, grip, hilt, pommel, gem, runes or fittings. Length to width about 6.5:1.
